prayerExcerpt.en-US: "If any one would be My disciple," says Our Saviour, "let him deny himself." The denial of self is, then, the royal road to perfection.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Se alguém quiser ser Meu discípulo", diz Nosso Salvador, "negue-se a si mesmo." A negação de si mesmo é, pois, o caminho real para a perfeição.

meta.face: An Irishman of about seventy, stocky and weathered, with a ruddy, windburnt, freckled complexion and a COMPACT, SQUARE face on a thick neck — the front of the head shaved from ear to ear in the Irish tonsure, leaving a broad, lined forehead, with thick, straight sandy-white hair falling behind the ears to the nape; a SHORT, BROAD, slightly UPTURNED nose, SMALL, bright, deep-set blue eyes creased at the corners under THICK, sandy-white brows, round, ruddy cheekbones, a WIDE, firm mouth, a broad, square chin under a SHORT, thick, BRISTLY sandy-white beard cut square; a steady, warm gaze. Not the long, big-boned, jutting-chinned, red-grey columban, the broad, clean-shaven, white-haired columba, the heart-shaped, dark-bearded fiaker, the long, narrow, flaxen-bearded finbarr, or the hooded, grey-bearded francis_paola.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. He is shown in a black cowl with a staff, bread and the bear that brought wood to his fire (Wikipedia; the Pfärrenbach mural in the lead image); the fire and the log cell are the book's engraving. The Irish tonsure follows his Irish origin as the book and his Reichenau biographers give it.
